Help [[Orozar Highstone]] avenge his brother's death by slaughtering a camp full of [[Stone Summit]] [[dwarf|dwarves]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find the Stone Summit camp concealed in [[Drakkar Lake]].
* Eradicate all Stone Summit in the camp.
* See Orozar Highstone for your reward.

===Reward===
* 300 [[Dwarf reputation points]]
* {{skill icon|Black Powder Mine}}
* {{skill icon|Great Dwarf Armor}}
* [[Onyx Gemstone]]

===Environmental changes===
* [[Dvalinn Stonebreaker]] will no longer [[spawn]] after this quest is completed.

==Walkthrough==
Go to the western side of the mountains and you'll start to come across plenty of Stone Summit. Follow the path to their camp, and [[pull]] groups away from the others, as they tend to be quite close together. At the end of the camp, you'll come across Dvalinn Stonebreaker amongst other Stone Summit. You have to kill everyone in the camp.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Orozar Highstone'''
:''[Difficulty: Master]"Poor [[Ural Highstone|Ural]]! At least he is with Dwayna now....''

:''I want the [[Stone Summit|Summit]] who did this to taste the pain of my '''vengeance''', even if it's not by my hand. I have promised to remain here to defend the encampment. Here's a thought: YOU go to that vile camp and dispense bloodshed the Stone Summit so richly deserve. Bring those murderers to justice!"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Revenge is best served with cold, cold steel. And fire.
|decline = You know doing this won't bring Ural back.
|ask = The '''Stone Summit''' of '''Drakkar Lake''' must pay for this transgression against my kin. Kill them all...and make it hurt! |indent = :: }}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Orozar Highstone'''
:''"I'm glad they are dead, but it won't bring my brother back. I will remain here in [[King Jalis]]'s service. Ural would have wanted it that way."''

==Notes==
{{anomaly| Occasionally the quest will be completed without killing Dvalinn Stonebreaker and his group.}}
